factual_sources.text:
Shipping and Return Rules

Employees leaving the company must return company equipment within 10 business days unless HR Admin approves an extension. Operations may provide a prepaid shipping label. Employees should not include personal items in return shipments.

Damaged or missing equipment is reviewed by HR Admin and IT Admin before any payroll or final-pay action. This policy does not authorize payroll deductions by itself.

Equipment Requests

Standard equipment includes a laptop, charger, headset, keyboard, mouse, and monitor. New-hire equipment is initiated by HR Admin and fulfilled by IT Admin. Replacement equipment requires the employee to state whether the request is due to breakage, loss, upgrade, or accessibility need.

Equipment above the standard bundle requires manager approval. Lost equipment that may contain company data must be reported to IT Admin immediately and should not wait for the next business day.

Data Retention

Customer contracts must be retained for seven years after expiration. Vendor agreements must be retained for six years after termination. Employee agreements must be retained according to HR retention rules and any legal hold instructions.

Draft contracts that never reach signature may be deleted after 18 months unless they are part of an active dispute, audit, or legal hold. Executed agreements must never be deleted from the contract repository.

Lost or Stolen Devices

Employees must report lost or stolen devices to IT Support within 2 hours of discovery. The report should include the device type, last known location, whether customer data may have been accessed, and whether the device was company-managed or personal.

Parental Leave Summary

Eligible full-time employees may receive up to 12 weeks of company-supported parental leave after 6 months of service. Local statutory benefits may apply separately. Employees should contact People Operations at least 60 days before the expected leave date when possible.

This document provides a company policy summary and does not provide legal advice.
